project_type: Monorepo with Go engine under engine/ and Strapi 5 CMS under cms/
build_system: Go modules for engine; npm + strapi build for CMS
test_framework: go test for engine; vitest for CMS
build_command: engine: CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./...; CMS: npm run build
test_command: engine: go test ./...; CMS: npm run test
verification_instructions: 1. Engine: cd engine && CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./... && go test ./...; 2. CMS: cd cms && npm run build && npm run test
environment_constraints: Worktree at /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/engine-cms-sync — all paths must be absolute under this root, NOT the parent repo.
contribution_requirements: Operator auth required on all engine admin endpoints; no secrets in responses (secret_ref only); follow existing code patterns; unit tests required; skip integration tests.

key_patterns.engine_admin_handlers: Handlers in engine/internal/httpapi/admin_handlers.go follow pattern: check requireStore, decode request, call store method, use a.fail on error, call writeJSON on success. Routes registered in admin.go mount() method wrapped with a.guard.Protect.
key_patterns.engine_admin_store: AdminStore interface in admin.go defines methods, satisfied by *config.PgStore. New store methods go in pgstore.go or pgstore_admin.go.
key_patterns.cms_admin_client: AdminClient class in admin-client.ts wraps all engine HTTP calls. Uses private request() method with Bearer auth. Each method maps to an engine endpoint.
key_patterns.cms_controller: Controllers like audit.ts resolve AdminClient config, handle errors (5xx recoverable, 4xx pass-through), return via ctx.body/ctx.status.
key_patterns.cms_routes: Routes in routes/index.ts under admin: { type: 'admin', routes: [...] } pattern with handler: 'controller.method'.
key_patterns.cms_admin_component: Components follow AuditViewer pattern: useFetchClient hook for requests, FetchState discriminated union for loading/error/ok, @strapi/design-system components.

directory_structure.cms/types/: TypeScript type definitions for engine API
